description: A machine as a netlist of simulation components: [machine] says what is connected to what, the other tables hold the values (see docs/machine-files.md). Generated by sim_netlist::json_schema; do not edit.

axis.description: A tool axis: a straight coordinate of the tool, from 0 to its stroke. Its limits are in [axis.<id>].

cable_chain.description: The axis drags a cable chain fixed at its 0 end (effects.cable_chain, values in [cable_chain]). Default false.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

incline_deg.description: Angle of the axis above the horizontal, deg; 90 is vertical, rising towards +. Default 0.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

key.description: Translation key of its name; default axis-<id>.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

stroke_m.description: Stroke, m; every axis but a rotary one has it.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

stroke_rad.description: Range of a rotary axis (one a rotary node turns), from 0, rad; in place of stroke_m.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

body.description: A rigid body the axes move: a carriage, a vertical axis.

axes.description: The axes it moves along: it moves with each of them. Ids of machine.axis nodes.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

payload_kg.description: Payload it carries while effects.payload is on and the payload is attached, kg.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

frame.description: The machine frame swaying along a horizontal axis on its own spring (effects.frame_compliance, elastic model only). At most one.

axis.description: The axis the frame sways along; it has to be horizontal. Id of a machine.axis node.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

mass_kg.description: The frame's mass in its sway, kg; bodies that do not move along the axis ride on it too.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

gearbox.description: The gearbox on a motor's shaft; its data is in [gearbox], shared by all gearboxes. A ratio of 1 is a coupling.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

motor.description: The motor that drives it. Id of a machine.motor node.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

guide.description: The linear guide of an axis, with its friction (LuGre with Stribeck, see mech::Lugre). Its id names its loss power, power.<id>, and its warmth.

axis.description: The axis it guides; one guide per axis at most. Id of a machine.axis node.

carries.description: Bodies whose weight across the axis it carries. Ids of machine.body nodes.

friction.description: The table of its friction values, laid out as [friction_x] of the shipped files.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

lever_axis.description: An axis whose travel shortens the lever (the overhang rises towards the guide). Id of a machine.axis node.

lever_m.description: Distance of the overhang's centre of mass from the guide with lever_axis at 0, m.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

overhang.description: A body that overhangs the guide: accelerated along overhang_axis it tilts the guide's carriages. Id of a machine.body node.

overhang_axis.description: The axis along which the overhang's acceleration tilts the guide. Id of a machine.axis node.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

side_load.description: The guide also carries the overhang's inertia force m a sideways. Default false.

spacing_m.description: Spacing of the guide's two carriages, m; the tilt puts 2 m a lever / spacing on them.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

id.description: Id of the machine, as the front ends list it; default the file name without its extension.

idler.description: A free pulley the belt runs over (effects.idlers): its inertia and bearing friction, at the belt speed past it.

at_m.description: Where the 3D view draws it, [x, y, z], m (from its body where it has one).

body.description: A body it rides on, for the 3D view: at_m is then from that body. Id of a machine.body node.

speed.description: Belt speed past it per speed of each axis (m/s per m/s). Keys: ids of machine.axis nodes.

linear_motor.description: An ironcore linear motor that drives an axis with no transmission (transmission::LinearMotor). Its motor's values read in N for N m and m for rad ([motor.<id>]: force constant in N/A, the forcer's mass as rotor_inertia_kgm2); its gearbox values ([gearbox.<id>], ratio 1) are the forcer's mounting.

axis.description: The axis it drives; one screw, rack, linear motor or rotary per axis. Id of a machine.axis node.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

motor.description: The motor it is; that motor has no gearbox node. Id of a machine.motor node.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

values.description: The table of its values, laid out as [linear_motor] of the registered linear motor axis (attraction force, pole pitch, guide friction coefficient).

linkage.description: A planar parallel linkage (crate sim-netlist, linkage.rs): two driven arms in the vertical x-z plane, one at each side of the base, each with a pair of forearms down to a plate that keeps its orientation (a five-bar with parallelograms, the planar delta). The tool is the plate's centre. A file with a linkage has two axes (no stroke: the working range below sets their range), two motors, a gearbox on each and the linkage; nothing else. The arms' joints read [joint] (bearing friction, stops), each motor its drive train as everywhere.

arms.description: The gearboxes that turn the arms: the first the arm at +x, the second the one at -x. Ids of machine.gearbox nodes.

axes.description: The tool's axes: the first across (x), the second up (z), from the shoulders' axis. Ids of machine.axis nodes.

base_radius_m.description: Shoulder axis from the centre, m.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

elbow_kg.description: Elbow block at the arm's end, kg.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

forearm_elbow_share.description: Share of a forearm pair's mass counted at the elbow, the rest at the plate, 0 to 1.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

forearm_m.description: Forearm, elbow to plate, m; longer than the upper arm.

forearm_spacing_m.description: Distance between the two rods of a forearm pair, m; the 3D view only. Default 0.

half_width_m.description: Working range: half its width, m.

height_edge_m.description: Working range: its height at the edges, m.

motor.description: A servo motor with its drive; its data is in [motor] and [drive], shared by all motors; [motor.<id>], [drive.<id>], [gearbox.<id>], [ratings.<id>] and [parts.<id>] give one motor its own.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

key.description: Translation key of its name; default motor-<id>.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

name.description: Translation key or plain text of the machine's name; default its id.

pulley.description: The toothed pulley on a gearbox's output, which feeds belt into the sections it ends.

at_m.description: Where the 3D view draws it, [x, y, z], m; default at an end of the first axis.

gearbox.description: The gearbox that turns it. Id of a machine.gearbox node.

inertia_kgm2.description: Inertia without the belt, kg m^2.

rack.description: A pinion on a gearbox's output that drives an axis along a rack (transmission::RackPinion; check rack-feed-force on rack.<motor>.feed_force).

axis.description: The axis it drives; one screw, rack, linear motor or rotary per axis. Id of a machine.axis node.

gearbox.description: The gearbox that turns the pinion. Id of a machine.gearbox node.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

values.description: The table of its values, laid out as [rack] of the registered rack axis (module, teeth, helix angle, efficiency, stiffness, backlash, pinion inertia, rated feed force).

rotary.description: A rotary table or joint on a gearbox's output: its axis turns, in rad. With strain_wave the gearbox is a strain wave gear (check strain-wave-life on strain_wave.<motor>.damage_rate).

axis.description: The axis it turns, which has stroke_rad; no body moves with it. Id of a machine.axis node.

gearbox.description: The gearbox that turns it. Id of a machine.gearbox node.

strain_wave.description: The table of the strain wave gear's life values, laid out as [strain_wave] of the registered rotary table.

screw.description: A ball screw on a gearbox's output (a gearbox of ratio 1 is the coupling) that drives an axis through its nut (transmission::BallScrew; checks screw-speed, screw-dn, screw-buckling, screw-static, screw-life). Its signals and checks are named by its motor: screw.<motor>.speed, joint.<motor>.force.

axis.description: The axis its nut drives; one screw, rack, linear motor or rotary per axis. Id of a machine.axis node.

gearbox.description: The gearbox that turns it. Id of a machine.gearbox node.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

values.description: The table of its values, laid out as [screw] of the registered screw axis (lead, diameters, length, mounting, efficiency, nut and bearing stiffness, preload, load ratings).

section.description: A belt section: the belt between two driven pulleys, or between a driven pulley and a clamp. Its tension is the same all along; idlers it runs over count as belt.

axes.description: How much longer the section gets per metre of each axis. Keys: ids of machine.axis nodes.

id.description: Stable id of the node; signals and other nodes refer to it.

key.description: Translation key of its name; default belt-section-<id>.

length_m.description: Length with every axis at 0, m.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.

pos.description: Where a node editor draws the node, [x, y]. Not read by the simulation.

oneOf.description: Dotted path of a number in the file.
